name: Siegfrizzle Drachensicher
personality: Has survived the impossible part and now trusts the ordinary details too much.
visual_intent: Siegfried Dragon Slayer free myth echo: broad low square ink splat,small bronze open-face warrior cap,tiny cream shoulder strip,ONE short blunt silver sword pointed down and small round shield with plain leaf badge. Fierce delighted asymmetric open grin with TWO upper teeth,no slain dragon/corpse
biography: Has survived the impossible part and now trusts the ordinary details too much. His HyperNorm shield displays a leaf that the inspection calls a minor detail. A dissonant card asks whether surviving a grand danger makes ordinary trust safer. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Das Unmögliche ist erledigt. Die Einzelheiten gelten als harmlos.

Severe uneven lids,closed enormous toothless uncompromising pout

note: FrizzleBob: Der Wettstreit ist beendet. Die Bedingungen ändern sich weiter.

name: Hagenschlag Zuständig
personality: Calls it loyalty when the decision has become difficult to defend.
visual_intent: Hagen with Spear: lean hooked comma ink blob,small dark leather cap,tiny plum collar,ONE short thick wooden spear with small dull iron tip and rolled blank oath-scroll. One heavy lid one raised suspicious brow,closed toothless crooked severe mouth,no blood

A dissonant card asks who is protected when loyalty becomes an explanation for everything. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Treue übernimmt vorläufig die Begründung.

note: FrizzleBob: Der Verlust wurde sorgfältig in einen Ablauf überführt.

note: FrizzleBob: Der Schatz ist vollständig. Die Gesellschaft bleibt ein Risiko.

name: Rheingold Kleinbestand
personality: Finds the river generous and the idea of sharing unexpectedly complicated.
visual_intent: Rhine Gold Hoarder Dwarf free myth mix: tall stocky pear ink blob,small rust mining cap and little woven beard TUFT BELOW mouth not concealing it,ONE small wooden chest with THREE gold lumps. Gleeful crooked open grin with ONE big upper tooth,one eyebrow high,no humanoid dwarf legs

A dissonant card remembers the river carrying things onward. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
note: FrizzleBob: Der Zufluss wurde als persönliche Zuständigkeit anerkannt.
